scope: existing +Z prismatic-hole-v1 counterbore records only; offline observable audit
measured_relation: two and only two cylindrical faces
same axis location/direction under recorded tolerance
outer radius greater than inner radius
one planar face adjacent to both cylinders
shoulder lies axially between nested-cylinder extents
negative_controls: any M30 single-cylinder blind or through record
two cylinders without shared planar adjacency
use of a counterbore label or reference sequence as a measurement input
stopping_rule: No counterbore feature claim or original-history recovery.
If adjacency or axis facts cannot be measured deterministically, retain unsupported and create no observable unit.
next_work: M32-002 may add one offline reporter and its controls; no new assets or production behavior are authorized.
